probe_source:
import GoLean.GoCore.Machine
open GoLean.GoCore GoLean.GoCore.Machine
def state : ExecState := { types := TypeEnv.reserved }
def entry (bytes : Array UInt8) (recovered := false) : PanicEntry :=
  ⟨.interface .string (.string ⟨bytes⟩), recovered⟩
theorem old_invalid_refusal : renderPanicHead state (entry #[0xff]) [] = none := by decide +kernel
theorem old_invalid_after_lf_refusal : renderPanicHead state (entry #[0x61,0x0a,0xff]) [] = none := by decide +kernel
theorem old_equal_repanic_refusal : renderPanicHead state (entry #[0x61] true) [entry #[0x61]] = none := by decide +kernel
#print axioms old_invalid_refusal
#print axioms old_invalid_after_lf_refusal
#print axioms old_equal_repanic_refusal

commands.output:
'old_invalid_refusal' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'old_invalid_after_lf_refusal' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'old_equal_repanic_refusal' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
